cl.x: Provide Sika® Plastiment®-55 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03).
Sika® Plastiment®-55 is a special formulated water reducing admixture based on selected polycarboxylate ethers, which provides a cost effective solution in achieving water reduction.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Sika® Plastiment®-55 is used to improve the efficiency of the water content in concrete mixes to achieve increased workability without loss of strength or to increase strength without loss of workability. It can be used for pumped and structural concrete. Sika® Plastiment®-55 is the ideal product for burnished finish concrete flooring.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Recommended dosage
cl.x: Recommended dosage is 400 ml ± 100 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material. This dosage can be increased to 800 ml 100 kg of total cementitious material to improve water reduction and increase setting time. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials with the particular mix design and materials.
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
